name: PLATO Discrete Non-Convex QPLIB Benchmark (Non-Binary)
description: Evaluates global optimisation solvers on 160 discrete non-convex QP instances from QPLIB with non-binary integer variables (general integers or mixed-binary), requiring proof of global optimality within a 3-hour time limit. Of the 160 instances, 104 were solved by at least one solver. Tests the ability of solvers to handle more complex discrete variable domains beyond binary.
domain: optimization, quadratic programming, mixed-integer programming, operations research
typical_sota_score: SHOT (99/104 solved, 83s unscaled mean); COPT (88/104, 173s); BARON (66/104, 657s); SCIP+CPLEX (40/104, 2062s). 3-hour time limit.
reputation: Specialist benchmark for non-binary discrete QCQP; maintained by Hans Mittelmann at ASU.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Hardware: Intel Xeon Gold 6230 (40 cores, 385GB RAM). Only 104/160 instances solved by any solver. 8 threads.
